points.description: States the difference in outputs: classification maps inputs to discrete labels/classes, while regression maps inputs to continuous (real) values. Equivalent wording earns the mark.
points.partial_credit: Half mark if only one of the two is correctly described (e.g. classification gives discrete labels but regression is not described, or described wrongly).

points.description: States how error is measured: in classification it is the number (or rate) of misclassifications; in regression it is based on the distance between true and predicted values (e.g. summed or squared differences). Equivalent wording and correct alternative error measures earn the mark.
points.partial_credit: Half mark if the error measure is given correctly for only one of the two tasks.
